limits: Same-kernel BOOTTIME, separate sessions; no cross-session subtraction.
Sampling targets 100 ms but actual gaps are reported. Missing workers and in-flight processes prevent complete scheduler attribution.
Runnable-wait deltas cover observed intervals, not callback latency. Near means within 100 ms of the command span, not proof of cause or mutex owner.
Linux CPU pressure is not Windows host CPU utilization. No causal host contention or middleware improvement is inferred from these samples.
